goal: Change the e-mail address for member 40055 to new.member@firstvalley.test and report the address the confirmation screen shows
description: Changed the e-mail address for member 40055 to new.member@firstvalley.test via Member Inquiry -> Member Record -> Contact Details -> Save Details. The 'DETAILS AMENDED' confirmation screen after saving only echoes Telephone and Post Code (not E-mail), so I re-opened Contact Details for member 40055 afterward to verify the saved value.
